what: Public author-fidelity examples (README, fidelity): the model author's implementation (Transformers v5.16.1, /public/reference-impl/) over the checkpoint dequantized to BF16, computed in FP32, teacher-forced in 1,024-token chunks (256 above 8,192 tokens); `author_logprobs[i]` is the log-probability of token i + 1. Sequences: prose 1,024, code 8,192, dialogue 8,192, records 32,768. Longer contexts have no author series here; they are compared with the engine's own reference.
